Method of Attack: Improper token validation in an API endpoint allowing attackers to receive a token with administrator-level privileges.
Impacted Systems: Cisco Application Policy Infrastructure Controller (APIC) devices
Attack Vector: Sending a crafted request to the affected API

Method of Attack: Insufficient access controls for an API running in the Data Network, allowing attackers to access privileged services or APIs, run containers, invoke host-level operations, and make limited configuration changes.
Attack Vector: Exploitation of insufficient access controls in an API

Method of Attack: Exploitation of an incorrectly configured TCP port (9075) to create, delete, or overwrite arbitrary files with root privileges, including adding unauthorized user accounts.
Impacted Systems: Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches running NX-OS
Attack Vector: Sending crafted TCP packets to an IP address configured on a local interface on TCP port 9075
